purpose: Make reusability and templating intrinsic to node identity while preserving definition lineage and per-instance state.

template_identity.law: A template is a governed node definition, never copied opaque markup.

instance_identity.law: Instantiation preserves template/definition lineage while creating independent mutable instance state and edges.

DUMB.definition: Deterministic bounded node with no autonomous planning authority.

SMART.definition: Reasoning-capable node whose proposals remain bounded by policy, validation and actuation authority.

attributes.law: Attributes describe governed characteristics; every attribute carries source attribution and version provenance.

attribution_graph.law: Attribution is graph data, not decorative metadata; derivation and authorship must remain traversable.

integration_contract.law: Integration edges are explicit instance data and cannot be inferred from copied DOM/markup adjacency.

hci_reuse_law: An HCI primitive is instantiated from a node template. Rendering may differ per instance, but semantic definition, typed contract and lineage remain stable.

authorship.source_basis: User-directed BRAINK node reuse, template, attribution and HCI governance requirements
